post.summary: Accept an irreversible durable scope fence
post.description: Exact current name, reason_code customer_request/workspace_closure/privacy_request, acknowledge_irreversible=true and acknowledge_retention=true are required. Requires Idempotency-Key; replays reauthorize and return current state. Owner deletes tenants; owner/admin deletes projects. Admin needs admin.content.delete, exact scope and recent MFA, including every child scope for tenant deletion.
